title: Best (2nd)
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.75 Numbered Discourses 4.75
  • 8. Apaṇṇakavagga 8. Sure Bet

Dutiyaaggasutta Best (2nd)

“Cattārimāni, bhikkhave, aggāni. “Mendicants, these four things are the best. Katamāni cattāri? What four? Rūpaggaṁ, vedanāggaṁ, saññāggaṁ, bhavaggaṁ—The best form, feeling, perception, and existence. Imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri aggānī”ti. These are the four things that are the best.”

Pañcamaṁ.
